hypothesis: Timing only successful solver calls omits verification, storage and failed attempts.
change: Added cumulative stage timing, injected-clock accounting tests, and elapsed-wall admission checks that explicitly do not interrupt active calls.

comparison.measurement: deterministic accounting test, not performance benchmark

limitations: Stage timers may overlap; wall limits reject future admissions rather than killing running calls; concurrent development can perturb real timings.
note: A small component iteration; final system claims require integrated evaluation.
